item.description: And then we took Kalonica [Quigley] in, who's now the fifth member of House House, and gave her a tour of this island. It was much smaller than the final thing, but it was really just an island with a bunch of trees and a few rocks, and maybe the red lookout tower was there, or an earlier version of it. It felt social and fun, like hanging out with your friends.

item.title: Pluribus Season 2 Makes One Of Its Best Characters A Series Regular
item.description: As the second season of Apple TV's Pluribus enters production, more details are emerging. On Nov. 13, we learned that a standout cast member from the show's first season will be promoted to a series regular.

item.title: The McElroys take sibling rivalry to a new level | Shelf Quest
item.description: Return of the best boys! Griffin and Justin McElroy take to the shelves at videogamesnewyork to pull out some of the deepest video game cuts we've seen so far! From NES classics like Shadowgate to modern favorites like Persona 4 Golden and everything between, the podcasting brothers have a nose for the hits. Watch to find out the truth about David Cage's Heavy Rain, why the Kinect might be the best console ever, and what happened to Griffin's gold Ocarina of Time cartridge... it's Shelf Quest!

item.title: Every GTA 6 Actor Rumored and Confirmed by Rockstar Ahead of Launch
item.description: It's been an excruciatingly long wait, but we're just days away from the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 . Ahead of the game's launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, Rockstar Games has yet to reveal any official details about the actors who will appear in GTA 6 , including the central couple, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.

item.title: Rings of Power Just Changed the Nazgul in 1 Terrifying Way: ‘They Still Have a Human Side’
item.description: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power season 3 sees Sauron begin to recruit the nine lieutenants that will one day become the Nazgûl, or Ringraiths. While details in J.R.R. Tolkien’s lore are a bit scarce when it comes to the gradual transformation of the Ringwraiths, Rings of Power initially presents the rings as miraculous gifts that transform the Men who wear them into Nazgnagôl, or "Ring-servants.” Rather than immediately enslaving their wearers, Sauron's rings heal their injuries, cure terrible afflictions, and grant them extraordinary power. The catch is that every gift brings its recipient closer to surrendering his freedom.

item.title: GTA 6 Release Day: Everything To Know To Be Ready On Day One
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is less than a week away, which means there's not much time to prepare for the biggest gaming launch of 2026. Fortunately, we've got some tips on what to expect on day one and how to make sure you get the best experience possible from Rockstar's record-breaking open-world adventure.

item.title: This 3D Pet SIM You Never Played Has Over 12,000 ‘Overwhelmingly Positive’ Reviews
item.description: Have you ever wanted to raise your own genetically mutated pup? Well, there's a Steam game focused on exactly that, and it probably deserves more success than it's managed in the four years since it launched. Wobbledogs , from developer Animal Uprising, is described on Steam as "a 3D pet simulation where you raise your own hive of mutating dogs."

item.title: Apple's Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History
item.description: In 2022, Apple was three years into its streaming experiment and still trying to find its footing. Aside from Ted Lasso , the tech giant hadn't released any breakout hits. And while a few sci-fi shows like For All Mankind and Foundation had fans, they weren't exactly mainstream success stories. Then everything changed when Apple took a bet on an unknown showrunner (with backing from an A-list actor) to create something revolutionary.

item.title: 20 Years Ago, the Best Sci-Fi Show of the Century Delivered the Most Epic Space Battle in TV History
item.description: Two decades later, this spectacle from Battlestar Galactica season 3’s “Exodus, Part 2” remains unforgettable sci-fi TV. It’s dazzling and horrifying, and still one of the coolest things ever broadcast on science-fiction television. From a tactical standpoint, the “Adama Maneuver” is absolutely bonkers and one of the riskiest spaceship tactics, perhaps ever (sorry, Vice-Admiral Holdo). What if the ship had gotten torn apart from ripping through the atmosphere? What if the FTL drive malfunctioned or didn’t activate in time? Somehow, it’s also not even the most visually impressive sequence in the episode.

item.title: Zelda Fans Who Loved Ocarina of Time Need to Play This Game Next
item.description: By now, you’ve probably had time to play The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on the Nintendo Switch 2. You’ve marveled at what a great job it does of bringing the classic Nintendo 64 adventure to a new generation, with visual improvements and quality-of-life changes to make it more palatable for that new audience. Maybe you’ve even run through it a second time.
